images.caption:
Villa Skeppet was the last home Alvar Aalto designed. Almost all the ideas and solutions that Aalto developed during his career are seen in Villa Skeppet. 
Aalto designed this house in for his friends the author Göran Schildt and his wife Christine. 

Material: Wood and brick
